product.name: Clearspace App
product.description: An app that intercepts impulsive app openings and limits time spent on selected apps to reduce compulsive phone use and digital distractions.

product.name: Mindful Awareness Notifications
product.description: Notifications that gently remind users to stay aware of their screen time habits and encourage mindful phone usage.

product.name: Focus Sessions
product.description: A feature that creates distraction-free periods by enabling calm windows and deep focus modes to help users concentrate.

product.name: App Limits
product.description: A tool to set boundaries on app usage by limiting the time spent on apps that consume excessive attention.
